LanguageData.Gun_SCAR-L_CQC_RWP.label: SCAR-L CQC
LanguageData.Gun_SCAR-L_CQC_RWP.description: The SCAR-L CQC is a compact and versatile assault rifle designed for short to medium-range combat. Known for its accuracy and reliability, it features a shorter barrel for improved maneuverability in close-quarters combat, while maintaining a high rate of fire. Ideal for tactical engagements, it provides colonists with the firepower needed to control the battlefield in tight spaces.
